author: Claude (Cloudreach Meshy generation worker), owner-authorized Meshy use (Standing owner direction 1, 15 Oct 2026)
workflow: agent-drafted multi-view concept from repo references (Meshy image-to-image nano-banana-pro) -> Meshy multi-image-to-3d (latest, quad remesh, PBR)
target_size_m: 6 x 6 m deck on 4 m stone pedestal with curved perch bar and rope rail

scale_normalisation.method: lossless: GLB scene roots wrapped in node 'metres_root' with uniform scale + translation; base at y=0, footprint centred on x/z

concepts.prompt: Creature landing perch platform: a 4 metre tall square pale limestone pedestal with stacked strata courses, topped by a 6 by 6 metre honey-timber deck, a curved wooden perch bar arching across one side for large birds to land on, and a rope rail on wooden posts around the deck edge. A small royal-blue pennant with gold trim on one post. Matches the plinth and bridge stonework references. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no cast background, no people. Materials: pale warm-grey weathered limestone (#9a8f80 to #b8ad9c, never pure white) with clearly stacked horizontal sedimentary strata and soft moss on the ledges; where present, slate-blue roof tile (#3d4a66), honey-coloured timber, cream plaster, royal-blue banner fabric with a small gold accent. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. Flat ground contact at the base.

visual_verdict: Good: stacked-strata stone pedestal, plank deck, curved timber perch bar, rope rail, blue pennant; 6 x 5.5 m deck, 7.4 m tall (pedestal ~5 m, brief said 4 m).
integration_flag: OFF - candidate only; stays flag-off until its scene passes code-blind judging
palette_check: no red/oxblood requested or observed; blue banners/roofs only
